desc: 墨青冷调版式下的麻灰套头连帽卫衣卖点页
leaf: 麻灰落肩抽绳套头连帽卫衣
name: 麻灰落肩抽绳连帽卫衣款

shots.intent: 用墨青通栏加灰白场板的版式开屏，一秒立住秋季套头连帽衫的百搭气质
shots.textZone: 顶部墨青通栏内一行主张位「{selling_point_1}」，其下一行短标签位「{callout_1}」，切角空牌内不填字

shots.intent: 把领圈双层罗纹与抽绳头这个第一卖点放大到一眼可读
shots.textZone: 左侧灰白插板上一行主张位「{selling_point_2}」，三点方标旁三行短标签位「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用上下两格同框放大普通卫衣领口塌软、表面起绒的日常烦恼
shots.textZone: 两格中部空档一行主张位「{selling_point_3}」，格内一律不给正文位

shots.intent: 以颈部以下裁切的素身造型给出落肩松量的穿着想象
用麻灰织面微距加气流曲线证明织纹匀整与透气版式意象
沿用源页四格步骤版式做水洗演示框架，结论格只留空框
shots.textZone: 四格下方两行短标签位「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」，第四结果格内只留空框不填任何数字

shots.intent: 并列三款同版型给出可选色域，胸口图位一律留空
shots.textZone: 通栏一行主张位「{selling_point_4}」，三款正下方各一枚空白方形色标位不填色号

shots.intent: 从背视帽型与下摆罗纹交代做工，替掉源页重复工艺块
承接源页规格表版式，用完全空白的账条与高亮列消除尺码疑虑
shots.textZone: 账条上方一行标题位「{callout_5}」，六行四列表格单元与右侧高亮列内部一律留空不填数字

shots.intent: 以切角空行动牌收口，把成交暗示留给占位文案而不给任何优惠数字
shots.textZone: 左上一行主张位「{selling_point_5}」，右下方牌上一行行动文案位「{callout_6}」

style.backgroundSystem: two alternating flat printed boards only: a pale iris-grey laminate field #E7E3EC and a deep petrol #16333B field carrying one iris-grey insert panel with a raw cut edge; the field always stays a flat board plane, never a street, room or in-store backdrop, never a fabric or bedding ground, never a dot matrix or tile grid print, never a gradient
style.direction: cool editorial print-shop menswear board commerce: two hard-edged flat boards, one top display band, one cut-corner label plate, ink-graphite lettering and a single lime pip rail
style.iconSystem: three hairline updraft curl glyphs rising off the knit face, small solid lime #BFD63C square index pips on a hairline rail, and one blank cut-corner plate, all at one stroke weight; no filled medallion, no shield, no cloud badge, no burst tag, no pictogram, no QR block
style.lightingSystem: cool 5600K studio light entering from the upper right, one broad soft key with a negative fill card on the left, a thin crisp shadow along the garment edge, fabric texture read by a soft skimming fill; no warm cast, no softbox bloom, no mirror specular
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool editorial menswear print-board system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pale iris-grey laminate field #E7E3EC, a deep petrol display ground #16333B, ink-graphite lettering #24262B and one lime #BFD63C accent plus one product-matched neutral; cool 5600K studio light entering from the upper right with a negative fill on the left, one thin crisp edge shadow and a soft skimming fill for fabric texture; flat two-tone laminated boards with a blind-embossed hairline rule and a raw cut paper edge, never a scenic, outdoor or gradient background and never a fabric, bedding or dot-matrix ground; one wide condensed grotesque display line on a horizontal rail with a light sans label face, no serif, no script, no brush lettering, no vertical type column; hairline updraft curl glyphs and solid square index pips as the only icon language; stable frontal garment registration and consistent scale on every screen; no colour changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no colour changes beyond #16333B, #E7E3EC, #24262B and #BFD63C plus one product-matched neutral
no serif, script, brush or retro lettering and no second display face
no scenic, outdoor, shop-interior, bedding or gradient ground on any screen
no warm amber cast, no bloom and no mirrored specular highlight on the knit
no QR block, no membership plate, no shop corner badge and no printed price row
no cloned garment, no duplicated seam and no floating hem without a contact shadow
style.presentationRules: one frontal garment registration and one consistent garment scale across the whole set; collar, drawcord tips, pouch opening and hem rib keep the same proportion screen to screen; the display band holds the top edge only and never overlaps the shoulder line; the chest graphic area always stays one blank rectangular image slot
style.surfaceSystem: matte laminated board sheets with one blind-embossed hairline rule and a visible raw cut paper edge, laid one sheet deep on a flat plane; no wood grain, no stone slab, no floor perspective, no textile surface
style.typography: one wide condensed grotesque display line held on a horizontal rail, paired with a light sans label face; copy budget is one display line plus at most three short labels per screen and every readable line arrives later as a placeholder; no serif, no script, no brush lettering, no vertical type column, no latin slogan row
